meta.description: Use when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Query and configure Codex Rules behavior and rule files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to understand or adjust Codex rule behavior

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在会话开始和用户提交时自动注入项目级说明,并在代码改动后注入对应文件的规则;动态输出会去重,且不修改工具输出。
howto.when: 当用户询问 Codex Rules 的行为、项目规则注入、支持的规则文件位置或环境配置时触发。

say.text: Codex Rules 支持哪些规则文件?
say.note: 会列出 CONTEXT.md、.omo/rules 等位置。
会解释 both、static 等模式的含义。

say.text: 环境变量 CODEX_RULES_DISABLED=1 有什么用?
say.note: 会说明这是关闭规则注入的开关。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, it injects project instructions on session start and user prompt, plus file-specific rules after apply_patch; dynamic output is deduplicated and not rewritten.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.

say_en.text: Which rule files does Codex Rules support?

say_en.note: Explains modes like both and static.
